# Barings BDC, Inc. Announces Conference Call to Discuss Third Quarter 2026 Results


October 07, 2026 6:15 am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_5701ed57cc4aab8aefbac4ed74a88730/baringsbdc/news/2026-10-07_Barings_BDC_Inc_Announces_Conference_Call_to_478.pdf)


CHARLOTTE, N.C.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Barings BDC, Inc. (NYSE: BBDC) (“Barings BDC” or the “Company”) announced today that it will report its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, on Thursday, November 5, 2026, after the market closes. Barings BDC, Inc. has scheduled a conference call to discuss its third quarter 2026 financial results for Friday, November 6, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET.


To listen to the call, please dial 877-407-8831 or 201-493-6736 approximately 10 minutes prior to the start of the call. A taped replay will be made available approximately two hours after the conclusion of the call and will remain available until November 13, 2026. To access the replay, please dial 877-660-6853 or 201-612-7415 and enter conference ID **13763218** .


Barings BDC’s quarterly financial results conference call will also be available via a live webcast on the investor relations section of its website at[https://ir.barings.com/ir-calendar](https://ir.barings.com/ir-calendar) . Access the website 15 minutes prior to the start of the call to download and install any necessary audio software. An archived webcast replay will be available on the Company's website until November 13, 2026.


**About Barings BDC, Inc.**


Barings BDC, Inc. (NYSE: BBDC) is a publicly traded, externally managed investment company that has elected to be treated as a business development company under the Investment Company Act of 1940. Barings BDC seeks to invest primarily in senior secured loans in middle-market companies that operate across a wide range of industries. Barings BDC's investment activities are managed by its investment adviser, Barings LLC, a leading global asset manager based in Charlotte, NC with $502+ billion* of AUM firm-wide. For more information, visit[www.baringsbdc.com](http://www.baringsbdc.com/) .


**About Barings LLC**


Barings is a $502 billion* global alternative asset manager that partners with institutional, insurance and wealth clients and supports leading businesses with flexible financing solutions. The firm, a subsidiary of MassMutual with a minority investment from MS&AD, seeks to deliver excess returns by leveraging its global scale and capabilities across credit, real assets, capital solutions and emerging markets.


*As of June 30, 2026
